image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a large common iguana perched on a thick branch inside what appears to be a glass enclosure. The iguana is facing left, with its head resting near the branch. Its skin texture is detailed, showing granular scales and larger plates on the head. A prominent dorsal crest runs down its neck and back. The lighting creates some glare on the right side, likely from the glass.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and consistent with an iguana. The dewlap is present under the chin, though partially shadowed.
